setting.help: Configure the API key used to find businesses and create CRM leads automatically.
setting.div: Get a key from Geoapify, then save it here. The key is stored in Odoo settings and is not shown in the lead search.

setting.help: Store a Foursquare Service API Key used for place search.
setting.div: Create a project in the Foursquare Developer Console, then generate a Service API Key in the project's Settings. Foursquare key setup guide

setting.help: Store the TomTom API key used to search places and create CRM leads.
setting.div: Add a TomTom key with Places Search API access. This is separate from routing API access. TomTom Places Search setup guide

setting.help: Configure the server-side Apify token used to search Google Maps business listings.
setting.div: Add an Apify API token. It is stored in Odoo settings and used only by the Odoo server.
